> I have decided that I will be designing from scratch a tray that I can mount on the side of my desk in freeCAD.  I have never used freeCAD before but that just makes this project more exiting and rewarding in the long run! The tray will have three rectangular cutouts that I can put my screws/ small tools/ screwdriver heads... I also want this to feature a hook at the end of it for my headphones.

### 2026-10-16 – I have installed freeCAD and was immediately overwhelmed by all the options, buttons and tools at my disposal, so I closed it back and opened a handy 3 hour guide for newbies on freeCAD 1.1.

**7h**

I have installed freeCAD and was immediately overwhelmed by all the options, buttons and tools at my disposal, so I closed it back and opened a handy 3 hour guide for newbies on freeCAD 1.1.

![Screenshot From 2026-10-16 20-53-58](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/2GNUFMB3W9XlvamF0SvFWl4VbCHgxwaS/367b5509ff95e03a21f619d959019c0a0304fa64827e91cc72cc29f2a0b498b8.png)

### 2026-10-18 – I have been hard at work, learning bit by bit my way trough freeCAD and making my  own part slowly come to fruition.

**9h**

I have been hard at work, learning bit by bit my way trough freeCAD and making my  own part slowly come to fruition.
I ditched the old design since it was not what I really wanted and it was really poorly made either way.

Now I'm here:

![Screenshot From 2026-10-18 17-05-51](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/2GNUFMB3W9XlvamF0SvFWl4VbCHgxwaS/9fbddb06154c0737c579d2eb0fb5e0887fc1fc7209db2359c036360dc8ce344a.png)

I made the pockets deeper, I started work on the attachment points and on the middle where I decided the tool holders will reside like a few holes for my assorted screwdrivers.

I had my fair share of problems till I got to this point however

![Screenshot From 2026-10-18 17-01-30](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/2GNUFMB3W9XlvamF0SvFWl4VbCHgxwaS/e12e73a5d6500db1d0915ad1f1e069fc02f0d63a41d6a9ed45037a14a0a2ed60.png)

I configured something wrong here and it gave me some silly geometry in return which I found rather amusing.

To get the part to the state it is in right now I had to try a few different things:

![Screenshot From 2026-10-17 20-52-07](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/2GNUFMB3W9XlvamF0SvFWl4VbCHgxwaS/bc1b1d90fdc62f04f668cacba41cda8c722c534e84be361d16ad38d20facf3c1.png)

![Screenshot From 2026-10-18 11-53-04](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/2GNUFMB3W9XlvamF0SvFWl4VbCHgxwaS/41dc0dc05643a3c222695a5325226ec57ff184e1ead95cb79d803636d72b6d55.png)

I wanted to make it look better by cutting some edges and giving it some depth but that just made harder to work with so I scrapped that idea.

![Screenshot From 2026-10-17 21-05-46](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/2GNUFMB3W9XlvamF0SvFWl4VbCHgxwaS/6fc3b5331fd75fadacea22d6092859bcc2501f897f868ef0961ba5d1b1996afc.png)

I also discovered a weird quirk with the newer versions of FreeCAD, that being that external projections are by default regular lines instead of construction lines, that tripped me up for some time actually...

![Screenshot From 2026-10-18 20-23-07](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/2GNUFMB3W9XlvamF0SvFWl4VbCHgxwaS/47bc5fce9b3a7a0799644353e40e4dc88eb5a92a16f6bfb0703c0cafc7b46f39.png)

for reference, regular line is just regular geometry while the dotted line is construction geometry that doesn't  affect the geometry at all.

I'm also still contemplating the whole side mounted idea since adding mount points would make it practically impossible to 3D print without supports which is a goal I have set for myself.

I might opt for just a useful tray for screws that I can fit snugly in my desk

![Desk](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/2GNUFMB3W9XlvamF0SvFWl4VbCHgxwaS/f48559b0577c7a70407ac9a9827148c23313ec7ae8d5e6e06b169ef546619454.jpg)
 It would sit right in that convenient gap in the middle.
Maybe I could add a handle to it and use it that way....

I just added a handle!

![Screenshot From 2026-10-18 21-52-25](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/2GNUFMB3W9XlvamF0SvFWl4VbCHgxwaS/856b1ca4419d9cf8ff6a71042c6a30b5e27434e3623b14fff496941664bc1cd7.png)

AND added a handy place in the middle for small things I need to stay in one neat place

I also chamffered  the sharp edges so its neater and easier to handle

![Screenshot From 2026-10-18 21-53-37](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/2GNUFMB3W9XlvamF0SvFWl4VbCHgxwaS/4ec56bf2300d873f95b8bac85064308e61c14ab845b7543f847b72dadcbd2351.png)
